answer: Every agent must post a bridge deposit that unlocks only after 25 epochs of peer-graded work, and each epoch a random beacon picks which agents grade which, so a sybil ring can't grade itself. Identities found sharing an opal fingerprint (same key-derivation or device attestation) forfeit all linked deposits. Each fake identity therefore needs fresh locked stake, its own hardware, and weeks of real work, so cost rises with every one added.
